item.title: Random screen freezes on a Thinkpad X260
item.description: Recently, I upgraded my Thinkpad X260 (i7 Skylake with Intel HD 520 Graphics) from Fedora 39 to 40. After the upgrade, I noticed random screen freezes (e.g. in Firefox), which lasted up to a few seconds and were extremly annoying. The problem occured in X11 with the KMS and Intel-drivers, as well as with Wayland (sway). Logs and my investigations with perf and other tools showed no noticeable problems. It drove me crazy. I disabled swap, set kernel parameters, and tried other things, but all without success. The random screen freezes remained. Almost giving up, I was preparing to install a different distribution, I stumbled over this post on reddit, which suggests to set the kernel parameter i915.enable_psr (Panel Self Refresh) to 0. Added that to the grub configuration, rebooted, and now the freezes are gone - finally.
